findings.detail: The plan SHA matches the reviewed v4 approvals. The implementation-authored schema is distinguished from original source contracts. Registry pins bind exact workflow, state, and agent source bytes and keep schema_version separate from a runtime workflow revision.

The profile validator parses JSON text directly, rejects duplicate decoded keys, enforces the byte/depth boundaries and schema without mutation, limits issues to fixed codes and known JSON Pointer paths, and separates structural validity/configuration from operational checks and approvals. Configured and enabled mock profiles do not grant real authority.

Snapshot canonicalization uses UTF-16 default key ordering and preserves array order. Snapshot identity binds project, caller version, workflow/state/agent raw pins, profile digest and full payload digest. createSnapshot applies the 2 MiB canonical-record-plus-LF cap. TC expected profile/bundle/snapshot vectors and the exact/+1-byte boundary are independently constructed with fixed source pins and literal expected hashes rather than product schema/serializer outputs.

Store publication captures and validates the caller record before its first await, writes a unique 0600 temp, syncs and closes it before hardlink publication, does not overwrite or roll back final names, syncs the containing directory for successful and equal-content publication, reports ambiguous link/directory-sync results as PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN, and permits retry to verify and sync the preserved final. Reads use no-follow opens, size and canonical-byte checks, identity/digest/workflow revalidation and deep-frozen returns.

CLI output is limited to the prescribed validation DTO, fixed error code, or snapshot hashes. File, parse, and storage failures omit raw profile text and filesystem error details; the independent CLI tests include sentinel-leak assertions and a static/preload side-effect check. Store tests use independent Node processes for equal/conflicting races, EEXIST directory-sync ordering, injected fs faults, kills around link/sync/response, and corruption/symlink/size checks.

The verification runner pins the accepted controls baseline and v4 plan, compares protected source inventories and dependency drift, runs targeted and full unit/build/plugin/source verification, then requires exact accepted UI/plugin output hashes and unchanged source fingerprints. UI gate omission is conditional on those checks passing. Runner evidence remains required before final review.
